CustomField.label: Approver 1
CustomField.description:
★R9 Level 1 of the approval chain: the Account Owner of the customer this invitee belongs to, copied from Account_Manager__c at submit time. This is what requirement.md means by "Account Owner (Level 1 Approver)".
Was Approver__c up to R8, when the chain was one rung and that rung was the submitter's manager. The rename is not cosmetic — a field called "Approver" on a record with five of them reads as "the approver", which is exactly what it is no longer.
Resolved once at submit time and frozen, like every level: a reorganisation halfway up a three-level chain must not reroute an item somebody is already looking at. The whole chain that was in force when the batch was submitted is the chain that decides it.
Never the submitter. An AM who owns the customer they are inviting would otherwise approve their own submission at level 1; ApprovalChainService drops the submitter wherever they appear in the chain and the levels compact upwards.
